# Excel score files

ExcelJS 4.4.0, MIT license. Browser build is stored locally and loads only when a teacher downloads an Excel template or current scores.

- https://github.com/exceljs/exceljs/tree/v4.4.0
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/exceljs@4.4.0/dist/exceljs.min.js
- License: `exceljs-LICENSE.txt`
# SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3 (mini build)

- Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.mini.min.js
- Documentation: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/standalone/
- License: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/LICENSE (Apache 2.0; included as sheetjs-LICENSE.txt)
- Used only when a teacher imports XLSX, including files generated by different Excel-compatible applications. Loaded locally on demand.
